# CTA, follow and review overlays for TikTok and Reels ads in Remotion

**Real reviews, comments and counts become CTA, follow, LIVE and review overlays placed inside one 9:16 safe box for every platform.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_2b131627cf41.webp" alt="Vertical clips get creator overlays: a CTA pill, a notification banner dropping in, a review proof card and a LIVE badge with viewer count." width="480"></p>

Eleven conversion overlays for short-form ads, UGC and creator videos, with presets per platform: CTA pill, follow tap prompt, story sticker tag, LIVE badge with viewer count, notification drop, review proof card, story caption bar, photo wall loop, follower counter and goal bar, comment callout (reply-to-comment) and subscribe-and-bell nudge. Presets use one universal 9:16 safe box built from TikTok, Meta Reels, YouTube Shorts and Snap specs, CTA timing from creator analysts (ask after value, never in the intro), native number formats, contrast and motion tokens, plus the FTC rules: reviews, comments and counts come from real data only and paid content is disclosed. Use when an ad or creator video needs a call to action, a subscribe or follow ask, a review or comment on screen, a LIVE badge or a counter. NOT for fake reviews, fake follower counts or copying a platform's logo.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill social-overlays                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills social-overlays --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Add a "Shop now" CTA pill at 0:12 and a follow prompt at the end of ./ad.mp4, 9:16"
- "Put the real customer review in ./review.json on screen as a proof card over my UGC clip"
- "Make a LIVE badge with a ticking viewer count for my stream highlight reel"
